identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][prune] Resolve issue-local terminal worktree topology safely

values.summary: Prepare and bind; add failing topology regressions; implement exact canonical resolution; validate and review; publish, merge, post-merge validate, close out, retain the receipt, and prune only through the repaired guard.

steps.action: Prepare, review, initialize, and bind the issue-local typed lifecycle
Add focused failing regressions and implement exact canonical topology resolution
Run FastWork proof, exact-revision review, and fix every actionable finding
Publish, shepherd exact-head checks, merge, post-merge validate, close out, retain receipt, and guarded-prune if safe

invariants: Eligibility requires exact branch, canonical root, and live Git topology identity
Invalid and ambiguous paths fail with unsafe_checkout
Terminal evidence and retained receipt bytes are unchanged
risks: A permissive relative-path rule could prune a same-suffix checkout
A sentinel special case could ignore branch or live topology identity
A repair could accidentally rewrite immutable terminal evidence
A test could prove only a helper while missing command-level behavior
stop_conditions: Any need to mutate #5340 or migrate terminal records
Any need to change Runtime code, use AWS, or add a dependency
Any proposed rule that accepts suffix-only or traversal-bearing identity
